description_for_human: An independent, checkable archive of the Lunenburg, Massachusetts town and school budget.
description_for_model: Read https://lunenburgbudgetproject.org/llms.txt first — it is written for you and states what this archive holds and what it does not. Every dataset is fetchable at https://lunenburgbudgetproject.org/api/tables, sized so you can decide before asking. Every figure traces to a published document with a URL and a sha256.

mcp.about: Eight tools over the same database, shaped so the documented mistakes cannot be made.
